slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly disciplined

early swims

swim at the pool when it opens, three mornings a week. getting into cold water before sunrise teaches your mind that comfort is optional and effort is normal.

learning an instrument

practise an instrument for fifteen minutes every day, no matter how badly it sounds. daily practice with slow progress is the purest discipline training there is.

meal prep sundays

cook all your lunches for the week every sunday. planning ahead turns a hundred small daily decisions into one, and that freedom makes discipline feel effortless.

a daily lesson streak

keep a streak of 5 minutes of learning every single day: a word, a fact, a painting. protecting a streak is how discipline becomes something you actually enjoy.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily lesson streak

keep a streak of 5 minutes of learning every day: a word, a fact, a painting. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and protecting a streak makes discipline fun.

slides.texte_overlay:
long distance walking

walk ten thousand steps a day, rain or shine. it's not hard, it's just relentless, and doing something relentless every day changes who you think you are.
